policy: First matching rule wins. Router defaults from the path (docs/01-app -> app, docs/02-pages -> pages, forum/app -> app, forum/pages -> pages). Status defaults to 'current'. A legacy rule must name the pinned-commit doc that supersedes it.

rules.reason: Synthetic answer imports next/router inside an App Router thread; the pinned App Router hook is next/navigation.
Synthetic answer exports getServerSideProps from a Server Component page; App Router pages fetch with an async component.
Synthetic answer creates pages/api in an App Router project; the pinned replacement is a route handler.
Synthetic answer tells an App Router user to add global CSS through pages/_app.js; the root layout owns it now.
Synthetic answer is written against middleware.js and its matcher; the pinned file marks middleware deprecated and renamed to proxy.
Synthetic answer uses the removed layout prop on next/image; the pinned component takes fill or width/height.
Synthetic answer applies the Pages-era dynamic() ssr:false option inside a Server Component; client boundaries replaced it.
Synthetic answer subscribes to router.events, which the App Router router object does not expose.
Synthetic answer reads request cookies through getServerSideProps in an App Router thread; the pinned API is cookies().
Synthetic answer recommends getInitialProps for a Pages project; the pinned Pages reference calls it a legacy API.
Synthetic answer uses the removed unstable_revalidate key; the pinned reference uses revalidate.
Synthetic answer solves router.query being undefined with the Pages isReady flag, a next/router-only workaround.
Synthetic answer wires page props through _app.js and Component.getInitialProps, the CRA-era pattern.
Synthetic answer disables body parsing with export const config in pages/api; App Router handlers use request.formData().
Synthetic answer pairs layout="fill" with objectFit; the layout prop no longer exists on next/image.
Synthetic answer renders on router.isFallback in a project that already moved dynamic routes to generateStaticParams.
Synthetic answer injects ServerStyleSheet through _document.js, the styled-components v4 Pages pattern.
The pinned App Router reference marks middleware.js deprecated in Next.js 16 and renamed to proxy.js.
The pinned Pages reference states getInitialProps is a legacy API and points at getStaticProps or getServerSideProps.
